fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck court connects to Cameron Blvd by open paved driveways. z19 satellite of both the NE and SW connections and 2026-04 Street-View along Cameron Blvd show no barrier arm, no sliding gate, no checkpoint pinch-point and no perimeter fence at the road. UNFI sign and flagpoles sit at the front, but the truck entrances are open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the truck entrance. No 1-3-vehicle-footprint structure beside the truck lane in any imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — requires a gate; there is none.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck court on the NW side between the dock face and the perimeter road gives ample interior holding before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The truck court runs the full NW length of the building; easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~40 estimate; docks run the full NW building face, partly shadowed/occluded by backed-in trailers in overhead imagery. Facility is a ~425,000 sq ft DC opened 2016.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Bank of drop trailers parked without tractors in the NW truck court — `dropArea` 25-50; `dropYard: true`.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single DC building (rooftop solar). The large building immediately NW is a separate, unrelated facility on its own parcel.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town in the Gilroy industrial fringe (south Santa Clara County), bordered by active row-crop farmland on the south and west; rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~33 acres for the developed footprint; additional undeveloped farmland lies on the SE of the parcel and is excluded from the active-yard perimeter.
